biotools.summary: UniTCR is a framework for unified cross-modality integration of T cell receptors and T cell transcriptomes, designed for low-resource-aware representation learning. It enables comprehensive T cell analysis and integrates scRNA and TCR data to improve T cell heterogeneity research.
